architecture_impossibility_assessment.reason: Plan section 10 says: 'Do not claim architecture impossibility unless P1-P5 are complete and independently verified.' P1-P5 ARE complete and verified, but the plan does not authorize an impossibility claim — it only authorizes handing off the repaired frontier and failed families. We hand off the verified frontier.
architecture_impossibility_assessment.what_is_proven: Under 5000U budget with the current 4-sleeve (+1 P4 variant) library and the repaired allocator, the ann/DD Pareto frontier is ann ~64% / DD ~18% with 5/5 positive segments. No combination of multi-symbol substitution (P3), reserve scaling (P4), or expanded allocator params (P5) improved on this.
architecture_impossibility_assessment.what_is_not_proven: Whether a fundamentally different martingale sleeve architecture (e.g., different TP models, different indicator gates, different direction modes) could break the frontier. Round 9 stayed within the R4-combo parameter family for sleeve construction.
